business.text: How do I fund it from my BTC?

You have two ways to get MUSD from your BTC on Mezo:

**Swap** — Sell ~0.00046 BTC for ~36 MUSD. Quick, no collateral, but you give up BTC.

**Borrow** — Lock ~0.036 BTC in a trove, borrow at least 1,800 MUSD (the protocol minimum). You only need to send 36 MUSD to the Operator; the rest stays in your wallet. Keeps your BTC exposure, but needs more capital and has liquidation risk.

Both need a small amount of BTC for gas. After you have MUSD, sign the draft card with your wallet to open the budget.
